the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The main point is that the composition arrow restricts: for the commutative square with top row R_1 x_{s_1, U, t_1} R_1 to R_1 and bottom row R_2 x_{s_2, U, t_2} R_2 to R_2, vertical arrows a x a and a, the scheme theoretic image of a x a is Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z by Varieties, scheme-theoretic-image-product-map; commutativity of the square then forces the bottom arrow to map Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z into Z. As in the proof of the perfect-field-image lemma, i_2(Z) is contained in Z and e_2 factors through Z, and the same argument as in that proof restricts the groupoid axioms of the septuple (U, R_2, s_2, t_2, c_2, e_2, i_2) to Z, so (U, Z, s_2|_Z, t_2|_Z, c_2|_Z) is a groupoid scheme over S.
